item.tib: g.yang grub 'dod rgu'i gter phreng gi chu sbyin bdud rtsi rgyun 'bebs
item.coloph: zhes pas 'dod rgu 'dzam b+ha lha yi chu sbyin 'di ni/ 'bru klong gdong mdzod smug po'i srid rgyal gsang phug nas nyag gter mkha' 'gro'i ming 'dzin bde chen dbang mos gter nas spyan drangs te/ slar srid rgyal lung bstan mdo smad gnas kyi gtso bo gsang ba yongs rdzong gi mdun zhol/ drang srong dga' ba'i skyed tshal lung rtogs bstan pa 'phel rgyas gling du mkha' 'gro'i ming 'dzin bde chen dbang mos shog ser las zhal bshus pa'o//
